sections.section: RULE - Employees Old Age Benefits (Contributions) Rules 1976
sections.description:
EMPLOYEES' OLD-GE BENEFITS (CONTRIBUTIONS)
EMPLOYEES' OLD-GE BENEFITS (CONTRIBUTIONS). RULES, 1976
(Gaz. of Pak. Extr. Pt. II, Aug. 9. 1976,
p. 1642.)
[S. R. O. 802 (1)/76‑Islamabad, the 9th August, 1976.‑Rules
made by Federal Government in exercise of the powers conferred by section 44 of
the Employees' Old‑Age Benefits Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976), the same having
been previously published as required by sub‑section (1) of the said
section].
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Employees' Old‑Age Benefits (Contributions) Rules, 1976.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context:‑
(a) 'Act' means the Employees'
Old‑Age Benefits Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976] ;
(b) Form' means a form annexed to
these rules ;
(c) Institution' means the State
Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan exercising and performing the powers and
functions of the Institution under the Act;
(d) `month' means Calendar month.
3. Contributions.‑‑(1) Subject to sub‑section (1)
of section 9 of the Act, contributions shall be payable on and from the date
the Act becomes applicable to the employer.
(2) Contributions fall due at the
end of the month to which they relate and shall be paid not later than the 15th
of the next following month.
(3) For the purpose of computing
the contributions payable every month at the rate specified in sub‑section
(1) of section 9 of the Act, the wages of every person in insurable employment
for that month shall be rounded off to the nearest rupee, that is to say, fifty
paisa or above shall be treated as one rupee and less than fifty paisa shall be
ignored. The amount of contributions payable on the total wages of all persons
in insurable employment for the month shall in like manner be rounded off to
the nearest rupee.
(4) Contributions shall be paid
into the Collection Accounts, of the Institution in the Banks authorised for
the purpose through EOBI Contributions Payment Slips in Form PR‑03 in
quadruplicate, separate slips being used for each Branch or Sub‑office of
(Subs. for
"a Bank" by Noti. S. R. O. 117 (1)/77, Feb. 10, 1977, Gaz. of Pak,
Extr 12 Feb. 1977, Pt. II, p. 257.)[an
industry or estab lishment.]
(5) Contributions payments made
by the employers shall be acknow ledged.
4. Non‑payment of contributions on due dates:- If the
employer fails to pay the contributions on the due date, the amount payable
shall be increased by one and one‑half per cent of such amount for every
month or part of a month for which the amount is in arrears, unless the reasons
for delay are established to the satisfaction of the Institution:
Provided that where, in the
opinion of the institution, the employer is a persistent defaulter, the amount
payable may be increased by the Institution by an amount not exceeding fifty
per cent of such amount, keeping in view the circumstances of default.
